EXPERIMENT COUNT CAP BREACH: 805 experiments vs 700 cap (105 over, new historic high); growth rate slowed this cycle (+3 vs .67's +8) which explains the wall-time improvement, but the structural 105-experiment excess continues to add ~5 min avg/experiment of unbounded overhead; cap discipline has eroded from 662 (.60) to 805 (.68) without enforcement

TIMEOUT WATCHDOG ABSENT: No per-experiment timeout cap in conductor dispatch loop; Exp 786 (77 min OOM thrash) and Exp 603 (44 min live training) run unbounded every milestone; a 30-min hard cap with graceful artifact write would save ~47 min/milestone; referenced in TEN consecutive retros without implementation

IMPROVEMENT IS NOT FROM GOVERNANCE: Both .67 (-91 min) and .68 (-61 min) wall-time improvements are driven by slower experiment-count growth, not governance fixes; slowest-5 composition UNCHANGED for ninth consecutive milestone confirms zero governance improvement applied; the improvement streak is fragile and will reverse the moment experiment count growth resumes at historical pace

DOC RECONCILIATION OVERHEAD: Per-experiment Claude Code haiku doc-update passes run individually after each experiment commit; batching all doc updates to a single pass at milestone end would reduce ~20 min/milestone of repeated file I/O

PREFLIGHT TEST SUITE LATENCY: Pre-flight test suite (GPU zombie killer, env validation, GGUF cache check) runs as first experiment; well-implemented but adds 5-8 min before any research work begins; not a critical bottleneck but observable in milestone log
